source_state: uncommitted P10 changes on top of the base commit (files below). 'before' artifacts ran the base commit unchanged in a separate worktree with its own target directory; 'after' artifacts ran this state.
profile: pre-release (release without LTO); the TensorOps example runs in release

commands.delta: TUR_BENCH_ONLY=delta cargo bench --offline -p tur-metal --bench kernels --profile pre-release
commands.paged: TUR_BENCH_ONLY=paged cargo bench --offline -p tur-metal --bench kernels --profile pre-release
commands.model: TUR_QWEN35_0_8B=<snapshot> TUR_BENCH_FORMATS=q8_0,q4k TUR_BENCH_KV=f16,q8 TUR_BENCH_PAGES=16 TUR_BENCH_PREFILL=2048 TUR_BENCH_CONTEXTS=8192 cargo bench --offline -p tur-engine --bench qwen3_5 --profile pre-release
commands.prefill: TUR_QWEN35_0_8B=<snapshot> TUR_BENCH_FORMATS=q8_0 TUR_BENCH_KV=f16 TUR_BENCH_PAGES=16 TUR_BENCH_PREFILL=2048,8192 TUR_BENCH_CONTEXTS=2048 cargo bench --offline -p tur-engine --bench qwen3_5 --profile pre-release
commands.checkpoint_tests: TUR_QWEN35_0_8B=<snapshot> TUR_QWEN35_GOLDEN=<golden> TUR_QWEN35_MTP_GOLDEN=<mtp golden> cargo nextest run --offline --cargo-profile pre-release --workspace --run-ignored ignored-only --test-threads 1
commands.shader_validation: MTL_SHADER_VALIDATION=1 MTL_DEBUG_LAYER=1 cargo nextest run --offline --cargo-profile pre-release -p tur-metal -p tur-engine --test-threads 1 --no-fail-fast

notes: delta-before/after-1..3 and model-before/after-1..2, prefill-before/after-1..3 are interleaved runs (before, after, before, ...); the report gives the best median per cell.
The base worktree's delta benchmark had its token list widened to 1/16/32/64/128/512/2048/8192 to match; nothing else changed.
paged-head-groups.json predates removing the four-heads-per-simdgroup kernel; its head_groups entries include 4 for that reason.

rejected-chunked-*.json and rejected-scan-scaled-vectors.json ran intermediate source states in this tree only. rejected-chunked-delta.json (final chunked kernels) and rejected-chunked-unstaged.json (first version) time the full chunked path; the ablation, tile-occupancy and split-accumulator files skipped the chunk-prepare kernel and time the shared prepare pass plus the sequential kernel.
rejected-chunked-delta.patch is the complete working tree including the chunked kernels, relative to the base commit.
An earlier A/B attempt shared CARGO_TARGET_DIR between the two trees, so Cargo ran one tree's binaries for both; those results were discarded and are not in this directory.
Golden files came from earlier sessions' reference-script outputs; the base commit passes all 8 checkpoint tests with them.
